lead: hey, i'm josie, or if you can pronounce it, thảo nghi.
blurb: i was born and raised in vietnam, and i moved to canada at the age of 17.

this has shaped my perspective on defining success. my friends and family often reassure me that i care too much not to make it, and i’m in the process of relearning how to enjoy the beautiful little things in life and take things at a slower pace.
i used to tell people that my hobby was reading the encyclopedia, and while that is cool, this is what i now enjoy:
hobbies: running it down in aram with my friends
going to live concerts (i went to 10 different concerts this year!)
filming mini vlogs that i will somehow <s>never</s> edit

moreLore.label: some more josie lore:
items: i’m trilingual: vietnamese, english, and korean, which i picked up through being the biggest koreaboo ever
i love the smell of jasmine since it reminds me of what my first ever flight smelled like
did i mention that i love music?
